drill-peck.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.

charge-beam.effect: Boosts the user's Special Attack by one stage

self-destruct.effect: Target's Defense is halved during damage. User faints.

explosion.effect: Target's Defense is halved during damage. User faints.

roar-of-time.effect: Forces the target to switch to a random ally.

soul-robbery.effect: The target's stat increases are stolen from it and applied to the user before dealing damage.

dark-hole.effect: This move has a 40% chance to inflict sleep on the target, it also bypasses substitute.

draco-barrage.effect: This move becomes a physical attack if the user's Attack is greater than its Special Attack. If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP. This move can hit Fairy-type Pokemon.

defeatist.name: Defeatist
defeatist.effect: While this Pokemon has ⅓ or less of its maximum HP, its Attack and Special Attack are halved.

iron-fist.name: Iron fist
iron-fist.effect: This Pokemon's punch-based attacks have their power multiplied by 1.3×.

flare-boost.name: Flare boost
flare-boost.effect: When burned, special attacks have 1.5× power. This Pokemon is also immune to burn damage.

illusion.name: Illusion
illusion.effect: Appears as last Pokemon in party until damaged. Moves have their power multiplied by 1.3× whilst disguised.

liquid-voice.name: Liquid voice
liquid-voice.effect: This Pokemon's sound-based moves become Water-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2×.

fatal-precision.name: Fatal precision
fatal-precision.effect: Super Effective Moves from this Pokemon can’t miss and receive a 20% damage boost.

blazing-soul.name: Blazing soul
blazing-soul.effect: If this Pokemon is at full HP, its Fire-type moves have their priority increased by 1.

blademaster.name: Blademaster
blademaster.effect: This Pokemon's blade-based attacks have their power multiplied by 1.2× and get a +1 critical hit ratio.

bad-company.name: Bad company
bad-company.effect: Prevents self-lowering stat drops and recoil.

as-one.name: As one
as-one.effect: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokemon. While this Pokemon is active, it prevents opposing Pokemon from using their Berries. This Ability activates before hazards and other Abilities take effect.

primal-armor.name: Primal armor
primal-armor.effect: This Pokemon receives 1/2 damage from supereffective attacks.

striker.name: Striker
striker.effect: This Pokemon's kick-based attacks have their power multiplied by 1.3.

stalwart.name: Stalwart
stalwart.effect: This Pokemon's moves cannot be redirected to a different target by any effect.

blubber-defense.name: Blubber defense
blubber-defense.effect: If this Pokemon is at full HP, damage taken from attacks is halved.

bone-zone.name: Bone zone
bone-zone.effect: Bone moves ignore immunities and deal double damage on not very effective.

phoenix-down.name: Phoenix down
phoenix-down.effect: Once per battle, this Pokemon restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, has its non-volatile status condition cured, and has its stat stages reset to 0 instead of fainting.

sage-power.name: Sage power
sage-power.effect: This Pokemon's Sp. Atk is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.

toxtricitite.name: Toxtricitite
toxtricitite.effect: Allows Toxtricity to Mega Evolve into Mega Toxtricity.

duraludite.name: Duraludite
duraludite.effect: Allows Duraludon to Mega Evolve into Mega Duraludon.

heavy-duty-boots.name: Heavy duty boots
heavy-duty-boots.effect: When switching in, the holder is unaffected by hazards on its side of the field.

eternamax-orb.name: Eternamax orb
eternamax-orb.effect: If held by an Eternatus, this item triggers its Primal Reversion in battle.
